description: Gets entries from the workflow history for the specified item.

database.description: Database to resolve an id against (default master).

id.description: The ID of the item to have its history items returned. Supply this or path.

identity.description: The user that has been associated with the enteries. Wildcards are supported.

language.description: The language that will be used as source language.

path.description: The path of the item to have its history items returned. Supply this or id.

name: common-get-item-workflow-event
